body: Founder, real-time: 'do the enhanced cursor hover state work.' Purely client-side (arena_state.heroes[i].team already populated everywhere, no wire changes needed). Hovering near a hero's floating health bar draws a relationship-colored bracket outline (self/ally/enemy, same colors the bar fill already uses) plus a tooltip with relationship, hero name, and real HP numbers near the cursor. Client-only rendering change, verified via clean build (no headless test possible for SDL2/GL mouse-hover rendering). Commit b0cdaca.
title: Enhanced cursor hover state, enemy vs ally (S170-69 revisited)
